title: Floor & Decor Announces New Store Opening in Cape Coral, Florida

# Floor & Decor Announces New Store Opening in Cape Coral, Florida


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_3e9b4774cad2466a1906c3dc44eaffd6/flooranddecor/news/2026-10-19_Floor_Decor_Announces_New_Store_Opening_in_Cape_307.pdf) October 19, 2026 4:35pm EDT


*—* *Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring opens its third Fort Myers-area location with $1,000 gift card giveaways, vendor demonstrations and more —*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the grand opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Cape Coral, Florida. Located at 2800 Pine Island Road, the store marks Floor & Decor's third location in the Fort Myers area and will host a Grand Opening Celebration running through November 13, featuring deals, giveaways, vendor demonstrations, and special events.


The Cape Coral store is led by Kevin Weise, Chief Executive Merchant, and opens with a team of approximately 40 associates.


Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.


"We're thrilled to open our doors in Cape Coral and continue growing alongside the Fort Myers community," said Weise. "This new store gives local homeowners and professionals even greater access to the quality, trend-forward hard-surface flooring and expert support they've come to expect from us."


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony**


Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Wednesday, October 21, at 9 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Cape Coral Chamber of Commerce. Horse Eyed Jake’s American Sliders Food Truck will also be on site from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. ET, giving away free food to the first 200 customers.


**Free Daily Giveaways for the First 100 Customers**


Each day, the first 100 customers will receive a free gift, with items rotating weekly:


- October 19–24: Free Bucket
- October 25–31: Free Lunch Box
- November 1–7: Free Hat
- November 8–13: Free T-Shirt


**Weekly $1,000 Gift Card Giveaway**


From October 19 through November 13, Floor & Decor will give away a $1,000 gift card each week. Customers can enter daily during each store visit for more chances to win. In addition, from October 19 through November 13, all Installation Materials will be 15% off*, only at the new Cape Coral location.


**Complimentary Morning Treats**


Kick off the week with Free Breakfast Mondays, offering a complimentary breakfast food truck every Monday morning from 7–10 a.m. ET, from October 19 through November 9.


**In-Store Vendor Demonstrations, 7 a.m.–12 p.m. ET**


Supplier representatives will be in store from 7 a.m. to noon throughout the celebration, providing live product demonstrations, answering questions, and sharing installation expertise. Featured vendor dates include:


- Laticrete: October 19–23
- wedi: October 26–30
- Schluter: November 5
- Mapei: November 9–13


Plus, a National Tile Contractors Association (NTCA) training session will be held on Thursday, October 29 at 5 p.m. ET at the Cape Coral store. Registration is available at:[https://www.tile-assn.com/events/EventDetails.aspx?id=2085106&group=](https://www.tile-assn.com/events/EventDetails.aspx?id=2085106&group=) .


**Store Facts & Features**


- Location: 2800 Pine Island Road, Cape Coral, FL 33903
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (239) 205-1527


*The 15% off tools & installation materials offer is valid on Grout, Mortar, Tools & Accessories, Surface Preparation Material, Self Leveler, Sealers, Cleaners, Uncoupling Membranes, Backer Board, Shower Systems, Primer, Floor Heating, Drains, Waterproofing, Niches, Pan Liners, Profiles and Trims, Caulk, Vents and Registers, Adhesives, Underlayment, Moldings, and Stair Treads & Stair Parts. Offer valid in-store only and not available for online purchases at flooranddecor.com. Limited to current in-store stock. Not valid on previous purchases. Cannot be combined with any other offer, coupon, or discount.


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.**


Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
